title: Freeze Development Engine V1 bootstrap interface contract
objective: Define and machine-enforce the stable Development Engine V1 bootstrap surface: authority order, permanent paths, schema/kind identities and CLI contracts, without byte-freezing dynamic state or granting business/runtime authority.
non_goals: freeze dynamic project_state handoff or context-map values byte-for-byte
rename or replace the certified V1 entrypoints
change canonical project-state or AWU schemas
activate runtime execution leverage or withdrawals
introduce paid services or mandatory LLM review

outputs.name: Development Engine V1 interface freeze policy

forbidden_semantics: Lot45 mutation remediation merge or adoption

required_invariants: Development Engine V1 certification evidence remains immutable and its candidate input and bundle identities remain unchanged
AGENTS.md remains the first human agent entrypoint and config/governance/project_state.json remains the sole mutable current-authorization source
engineering/CONTEXT_MAP.json remains generated bounded routing and never overrides canonical state
engineering/handoff/CURRENT.json remains a non-authoritative resume hint
active AWU resolution remains scripts/governance/resolve_active_awu.py and fails closed on ambiguity
live Git verification remains scripts/governance/verify_external_git_state.py --mode github before writes
V1 freezes path schema/kind and CLI compatibility contracts but does not freeze dynamic state values or generated status bytes
incompatible V1 interface changes require an explicit later interface version rather than silent mutation
BOOT-FINDING-001 remains observed and business development remains paused
acceptance_criteria: machine-readable freeze policy enumerates the V1 authority order permanent paths JSON identities and CLI commands
validator proves each frozen path exists and each JSON interface has its required schema/kind identity
validator proves AGENTS bootstrap order and authority statements still point to canonical state context map and active AWU resolver
validator proves certified V1 evidence verdict candidate identity input identity and bundle identity remain exact
selftests reject path drift authority inversion schema/kind drift command drift and attempted dynamic byte-freeze semantics
no business candidate runtime or historical evidence is mutated

done_when: V1 bootstrap authority/path/schema/CLI surface is machine-readable and fail-closed
dynamic state remains evolvable without invalidating V1 compatibility
fresh agents retain the same three-file bootstrap and single-AWU execution route
business development remains paused Lot46 locked and BOOT-FINDING-001 visible
